summary: Energy Services of America Corporation filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to announce an update to its investor relations slide deck in connection with its presentation at the Midwest IDEAS Conference in Chicago on August 27, 2026. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, or capital action. It is a routine current report providing notice of a conference presentation and updated investor materials. No deal terms, recommendations, advisors, or transactional details are disclosed. There is nothing to monitor from a special-situations or risk-arbitrage perspective.
